descriptions.nominal_voltage_v: Nominal phase voltage used when the meter configuration does not provide a usable rated voltage.
descriptions.voltage_warning_percent: Relative voltage deviation that creates a provisional warning.
descriptions.voltage_critical_percent: Relative voltage deviation that creates a provisional high-severity electrical-stress signal.
descriptions.expected_interval_minutes: Expected profile interval when the workbook does not make it determinable.
descriptions.long_gap_intervals: Number of expected intervals that constitutes a long profile gap.
descriptions.minimum_profile_window_days: Minimum profile window before trend-dependent checks are considered complete.
descriptions.recurrent_event_count: Number of comparable events that makes a pattern recurrent.
descriptions.low_pf_limit: Power-factor boundary used only when power evidence is sufficient.
descriptions.minimum_power_for_pf_w: Minimum active power at which low PF is interpreted.
descriptions.rtc_drift_minutes_per_year: Provisional RTC drift limit; edit for model-specific use.
descriptions.minimum_profile_records: Minimum non-empty block-load records needed for profile checks.
descriptions.repeated_reading_run: Repeated-value run length treated as a possible mapping or data-quality anomaly.
